scope: Complete 56-frame full-source regression after the native HDR resized-input range correction. All paired original/proxy/identity bytes and fresh cut results pass. Measured wall variation persists and its maximum adjacent change increases; temporal quality, physical HDR and source-rate Live remain unqualified.

pairedComparison.scope: All exact timing, source links, model/settings, payload hashes and finite checks pass. Full per-frame enhanced differences remain in the pinned audit. A changed enhanced value is not an error relative to ground truth.

freshCuts.scope: Exactly two sequential fresh one-frame processes at the automatic cuts. CPU audits/review overlapped these diagnostic controls; their wall time is not throughput.

wall.domain: Linear BT.2020 Y in nits. Same fixed unaligned full-resolution ROI; no mask/registration/photometric normalization.
wall.interpretation: Maximum and RMS adjacent enhancement-residual changes increase in this fixed unaligned region. Mean residual is lower. This contract correction does not eliminate the measured variation; no motion registration, perceptual threshold or quality improvement is inferred.

resources.interpretation: The new sampled startup-region peak is 1,012,121,600 bytes versus 577,323,008 bytes historically. It falls to 75,726,848 bytes by 49.851 seconds. From 120 seconds onward new RSS remains below 214 MiB, with identical retained MLX active values at every matched frame boundary. The higher startup peak remains an unexplained observation, without a demonstrated progressive leak or cause.
limitations: One sequential offline capture per version, not randomized or repeated; no causal throughput comparison.
RSS is ps -o rss for the benchmark process sampled about every0.5s; sub-sample transients and child processes are not measured.
The fixed elapsed-time windows are descriptive observations, not instrumented model/capture phase boundaries.

Manifest elapsed starts after input preflight/model inventory and includes runtime provenance/model startup, frame readback/write, and final model validation; process elapsed additionally includes earlier work and exit.
Per-frame MLX snapshots follow synchronous four-view readbacks and disk writes; no host timestamp joins them to RSS samples. No post-reset/teardown MLX snapshot exists.
MLX active/cache/peak-active are allocator counters, not total process RSS or physical unified-memory footprint; these values must not be subtracted from RSS to attribute ownership.
The configured256MiB MLX cache policy is not a measured hard peak cap; both captures report some cache snapshots above it.
Stable observed late RSS and frame-boundary active allocation do not prove absence of leaks over longer sessions or hard resource bounds.

Extra clamp tensor logical size does not predict transient allocation, JIT/driver allocation, residency, memory compression, or allocator behavior. No attributed explanation for the higher RSS spike is established.
Historical binary hashes and source revisions are preserved; source hashes are validated against their Git objects, not overwritten with current hashes.
